# Keep identity change pose
The character from the reference moves like the driving video (<Video 2>); the shot's framing stays.

**Inputs**: Load Video `plate` (the shot) and `subject mask` (white = replace; any segmenter, saved as a
video); Load Image `character` (the new character; for match-proportions the shoulders must be visible). Load Video `driving` = <Video 2>.
**Pose control**: Load Video `pose render` = a drawn pose video of the DRIVING clip (DWPose / SDPose render), through H3 Mask-Aware ControlNet (no control on kept plate).
**Head Size Mode**: `match character proportions` - set the SAME mode on H3 Subject Crop and H3 Family Presets.
**Order**: crop around the subject (head room) -> structured prompt (Family Presets -> editable in Prompt
Editor) -> Reference to Video (<Picture 1> character, <Video 1> cropped plate) -> latent mask from
head_room_masks -> Masked Replace -> sample -> decode -> Subject Uncrop with head_room_masks -> save.
**Prompt**: Family Presets writes a fixed template; run once and the Prompt Editor shows it - type in it
to send your edit instead (use_edited_text turns on; turn it off to take the template again).
**Settings**: starting values (official H3 r2v template: res_multistep, simple, 20 steps, guider cfg 1);
not yet validated on H3 weights. Full guide: docs/character_replacement.md in the MiniMax H3 Suite.
